name: Security review
description: For code that handles user input, money or credentials: a security auditor (Semgrep plus a manual audit) reviews the build and sends risky findings back to the Builder, up to twice.

afterBuild.name: Security reviewer
afterBuild.purpose: Scans the code with Semgrep and audits it by hand for misuse and data leaks, and sends it back to Dev if something is risky.
produces: .devcrew/security.md: a verdict and security findings by severity
